wsdl:definitions.wsdl:documentation: Web Service to access data and add data to MagnetMail.

wsdl:operation.name: sendMessageToGroup
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: BETA: Send message to a group.

wsdl:operation.name: getRecipientHistory
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: BETA: Get recipient history based on the recipient_id.

wsdl:operation.name: getUnsubscribes
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get list of recipients that have unsubscribed from account.

wsdl:operation.name: getSpamComplaints
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get list of recipients that have reported a message as spam.

wsdl:operation.name: getRecipientDetails
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get recipient details based on the recipient_id.

wsdl:operation.name: getMessages
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns a list of messages by different criterion. Messages can be filtered by sent date , create date, archive status, hide status, if it has fax, if it has email.

wsdl:operation.name: getMessagesUTC
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Returns a list of messages by different criterion. Messages can be filtered by sent date , create date, archive status, hide status, if it has fax, if it has email. Dates returned in UTC format

wsdl:operation.name: getLinkURLs
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Return links in a message that were tracked

wsdl:operation.name: getOverallTracking
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Return overall tracking data for a message

wsdl:operation.name: getDetailedTracking
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get detailed tracking data for a message.

wsdl:operation.name: getDetailedTrackingUTC
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get detailed tracking data for a message. UTC Times returned for dates

wsdl:operation.name: addGroup
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Add a recipient group to your account.

wsdl:operation.name: getGroups
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes 3 arguments - user_id, display_status and subscription_groups. Returns an array of 'group' type. (Deprecated, use getGroupsEx instead.)

wsdl:operation.name: getGroupsUTC
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes 3 arguments - user_id, display_status and subscription_groups. Returns an array of 'group' type, UTC formatted dates

wsdl:operation.name: uploadListQueue
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes an upload job and queues it for upload. Returns status in a complex type.The argument 'csvData' is your contact data in csv format. 'replace_group' specifies if recipients in group should be replaced with new list. 'update_dups' specifies if existing contact records should be overwritten with new values. 'header_line' specifies if your csvData has a header line. 'mapping_name' is name for the mapping between your headers and magnetMail fields. MM_1 thro MM_42 are names of MagnetMail fields to which your fields in csvData are mapped to. See API documentation for details of these fields.

wsdl:operation.name: uploadListQueueTest
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes an upload job and queues it for upload. Returns status in a complex type.The argument 'csvData' is your contact data in csv format. 'replace_group' specifies if recipients in group should be replaced with new list. 'update_dups' specifies if existing contact records should be overwritten with new values. 'header_line' specifies if your csvData has a header line. 'mapping_name' is name for the mapping between your headers and magnetMail fields. MM_1 thro MM_42 are names of MagnetMail fields to which your fields in csvData are mapped to. See API documentation for details of these fields.

wsdl:operation.name: getUploadJobStatus
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes a jobid and returns the status of an upload jobid.

wsdl:operation.name: getUploadJobStatusUTC
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes a jobid and returns the status of an upload jobid. Dates returned in UTC

wsdl:operation.name: getRecipientFields
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes a user_id as argument and returns contact fields defined in that account. Returns 2 values for each user1 - fieldNameText and fieldNameValue.

wsdl:operation.name: getSavedSearches
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get an array of saved searches in the account.

wsdl:operation.name: runSavedSearch
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Run a saved search in the account.

wsdl:operation.name: getErrorDetails
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Takes an error_nbr and returns details on that error.

wsdl:operation.name: getSuppressedRecipientList
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get the list of suppressed recipients based on date range and/or groupId

wsdl:operation.name: getRecipientGroups
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: get the groups that a recipient belongs to

wsdl:operation.name: getMessageListUtc
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Get A List Of Messages Using UTC Date Times

wsdl:operation.name: GetUploadInitialQueueJobStatus
wsdl:operation.wsdl:documentation: Upload Initial Queue Job Status In BETA
